payload.summary: Authored the approved ri-08 plan around an atomic PostgreSQL projection key, a short reconciliation transaction, and an optional persist-first autopilot seam. Discovery, direction, and plan approval were inherited from the approved roadmap batch; ri-09 live mirroring remains explicitly out of scope.
completed_work: Created proposal, design, three delta specs, SQL/OpenAPI contracts, TDD-ordered tasks, and a four-package coordinated DAG.
Passed strict OpenSpec, work-package schema, DAG, lock, scope-overlap, and parallel-zone validation.

decisions.title: Enforce projection identity in PostgreSQL
decisions.rationale: A partial unique expression index plus ON CONFLICT is the only considered approach that atomically arbitrates concurrent submitters.

decisions.title: Keep loop-state authoritative through an optional outbox seam
decisions.rationale: Projection runs only after state persistence and resume reconciliation derives queue rows from loaded LoopState without feeding results back.

decisions.title: Preserve coordinator-free fallback tiers
decisions.rationale: The projection callback defaults to absent; local-parallel and sequential execution import or call no coordinator queue surface.

decisions.title: Treat roadmap approval as both planning gates
decisions.rationale: The user approved the roadmap batch and the parent explicitly fixed the atomic PostgreSQL direction, so no interactive discovery or approval questions were reopened.

next_steps: Implement wp-contracts first, then dispatch wp-coordinator-queue and wp-bridge-projection in parallel.
Run real PostgreSQL concurrency tests before accepting the unique-index/RPC behavior.
Keep live phase transition registration and kanban latency checks for ri-09.
